messages:
SRE-Oncall: SLO alert (hosted-infer.euw2): 5xx/timeouts p99 spiked at 17:03 UTC. Seeing handshake/timeouts from gateway -> model-proxy. Can anyone pick this up? Alarm: https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/12345
observability-bot: [ALERT] SLO_BURN hosted-infer.euw2 p99>600ms — triggered 17:03 UTC. auto-mitigation: none.
Maria L: On it. Pulling traces now. curl to model-proxy-42 returns "tls: handshake timeout". Starting tcpdump on gw-euw2-03 (interface eth0).
Ajay P: Logs show intermittent x509 errors from proxy -> model-proxy: `2026-03-15T17:02:58Z ERROR proxy tls: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority` — maybe cert rotation? Also 503s from authz around same time.
Katie: Any recent deploys to proxy or authz? I'm querying deploy events.
Ben R: No infra deploys in last 48h. We did a scaling event earlier but turned off auto-burst. Could be NAT ephemeral ports — we've seen that cause handshake failures.
Maria L: tcpdump: seeing SYN then RST from model-proxy within 1s. PID 2234 on proxy has many TIME_WAIT sockets. Restarting proxy on gw-euw2-03 with graceful drain: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/gateway-proxy -n infra --grace-period=30s`
Ajay P: Also seeing upstream authz p99 spike (~600ms). If authz delays TLS handshake, proxy gives up -> 502. Correlating traces now.
Maria L: After restart error rate on gw-euw2-03 dropped ~80%. SLO trend heading down. Hypothesis: connection exhaustion + authz latency ripple -> handshake timeouts. Created interim mitigation: bump `net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max` and `net.core.somaxconn` on gateway nodes and added a short conntrack cleanup cron.
SRE-Oncall: Good. Please add repro steps & dashboard graphs for support and mark customer impact. Also add runbook note for conntrack checks.
Maria L: Will file INC-2026 with timeline, logs, pcap snippets, dashboard links, and short repro: `for i in {1..100}; do curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.euw2.redwood.ai/v1/infer || echo "FAIL"; done` — shows ~5% 502s during affected window. I'll follow up with a postmortem.
Katie: Adding alerts: conntrack utilization, tcp retransmit rate, and authz latency at p95.
Ben R: I'll schedule a config roll to make conntrack increase permanent after PM signoff.
SRE-Oncall: Thanks all — keep updates here. Closing if no further spikes over next 2 hours.
